STEP 10. Check connectors C-54 <2.4L Engine> or C-55 
<3.0L Engine> and C-61 <2.4L Engine> or C-63 <3.0L 
Engine> at PCM and B-38 at output shaft speed sensor for 
damage.
Q: Are the connectors in good condition?
YES : Go to Step 11.
NO : Repair or replace it. Refer to GROUP 00E, Harness 
Connector Inspection P.00E-2.
STEP 11. Check the continuity at output shaft speed 
sensor connector B-38.
(1) Disconnect connector B-38 and measure at the harness 
side.
(2) Check for the continuity between terminal 1 and ground.
• Should be less than 2 ohm.
Q: Is the continuity normal?
YES : Go to Step 12.
NO : Repair it because of harness open circuit or damage 
between output shaft speed sensor connector B-38 
terminal 1 and PCM connector C-54 <2.4L Engine> or 
C-55 <3.0L Engine> terminal 57.
